critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 due to Pydantic ValidationError: 'location Field required' on the synthesized multi_lot lot_listing dict in routes/listings.py:366-397. Triggered by the iter187 pre-seeded multi-item listing 269a9f90-6741-46ea-b29d-e7126b172f35 (no location set). The dict at line 366 sets city/region/country but never sets the required `location` field on Listing model. Affects ALL marketplace browsing whenever any multi-item listing exists. Fix: add `"location": ml.get("location") or f"{ml.get('city','')}, {ml.get('region','')}".strip(', ')` (or similar) to the lot_listing dict.

rca_of_the_issue: GET /api/listings 500 RCA: routes/listings.py merges multi_item_listings into the marketplace results by synthesizing per-lot Listing-shaped dicts at line 366. The dict sets city/region/country/seller_province/seller_city but never sets `location`, which is a REQUIRED field on the Listing pydantic model (validated at line 431 `Listing(**listing)`). The iter187 seed 269a9f90 was the first multi-item listing without a location pre-populated, so any GET /api/listings now raises 'location Field required'. Fix is one line: add `"location": ml.get("location") or ", ".join(filter(None, [ml.get("city"), ml.get("region")])) or "Canada"` to the lot_listing dict around line 377. Reproduction: `curl https://prod-verify-2.preview.emergentagent.com/api/listings?limit=5` → 500.
